summary: Turn your Kobo into a remote control for your computer.
page_description: Pair with your computer and run favorite actions from large, clear controls.
release_notes: The keyboard types every symbol now: on the ?123 keys, tap Shift for % $ ^ * [ ] { } < > \ | ~ and the backtick.

steps.text: Lay out your pads on the computer.
Once per reader: with it plugged in over USB, run kobo setup --enable-ssh. Then save it so the commands below find it on Wi-Fi without an address.
Prepare the helper. It prints the address and code Deck asks for.
Let the reader trust the helper, so Deck can check it is talking to your computer.
Start the helper, then enter the address and code on the reader.
Send the layout to the reader.
